scope: DIRECTION_CERTIFICATION_ONLY; no G, accepted state, nonlinear root solve, Time advancement, CFD, build, native interface change or AI
frozen_context: EXP024 verified step738 first TEqn C; original fields/oldTime/prevIter/types/dimensions retained; derived internal Gamma only, original calculated patch fixed
kernel: Exact copies of DEC030 analytic full face/Euler/latent/nonorth/source Jv; unchanged inherited GMRES(20), two MGS passes, right positive diagonal preconditioner, projected L2 1e-11 early exit; final extra direct Jv independent of recurrence
old_margin: record only, no positivity gate in this NEW experiment; original code and prior conclusions unchanged
rhs: native complete same-state unrelaxed matrix A(T)*T-b(T); frozen per seed before Krylov; norm = sum(abs(original H_native)); independent face RHS also checked with this SAME norm
roundoff: original gamma256 * sum(absolute-composition-Jv-bound + abs(H_native))/fixed_native_RHS_L1; report projected/preconditioned/weighted norms separately, no replacement of true norm

calibration.schedule: 3 original known roots + 3 clip-side bases + 6 directions * 2 trial R = 18 R; 6 Jv; reuse immutable old format/negative/nonzero-sweep evidence SHA
calibration.directions: alternating +/-1 at solid/mushy/liquid; exact Ts exterior negative; exact Tl exterior positive; Ts+0.01K interior positive
calibration.Gamma_prime: strict mushy 1/delta; exact threshold and pure phase0, outside selector

real_diagnostic.normalization: u=d/max(abs(d)), no new Jv; use final charged Jd divided by the same norm
real_diagnostic.activity_side: entire segment stays in original pure/mushy interval; at exact Ts/Tl only original exterior side allowed. Invalid predefined sample counted/rejected, not retuned
real_diagnostic.FD_checks: native and independent face residual differences versus reused Ju; relative <=2e-6 and induced FE <2e-10
real_diagnostic.merit: original fixed-s Phi, no weights or tolerances changed; report base/trial Phi and difference/h, predictions and activity. Diagnostics never accepted or propagated

accounting: count before every requested action, including failed/rejected samples; no action exceeds its category cap; cache reuse/linear scaling adds no Jv. All restore/hash/independent arithmetic/I/O work counted in wall. No retry, no source edits after preregistration. Provenance/calibration/interface/time failure stops batch; a fixed-seed linear/side failure stops that direction, only the other preplanned independent seed may proceed if trusted/budgeted. No nonlinear candidate acceptance.

resources.warning_policy: MONITORED_ONLY; maximum child/controller RSS and retained data stage-end observations, not hard memory/disk isolation
